Date: Tue, 08 Jul 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Evening logistics for Thurs summit — staggered arrivals, late plates & kitchen handoff

Hi Rosa,

Thanks again for coordinating the catering for our Harrington Systems summit this Thursday (7/17). Two things that came up in prep with the customer and our ops team:

1) We have a chunk of attendees (around 24) arriving between 7:15–7:45pm due to late flights. Can the kitchen support a second brief service window (light hot plates) around 7:45–8:05 for late arrivals without impacting the plated service for the main group at 7:00pm?

2) Harrington has a short VIP reception (6:30–7:00pm) that will be in the foyer. We need clear staging for when to release the plated entrées to the main room so the kitchen doesn’t send all trays at once. Can you confirm a handoff protocol with the venue (e.g., 3-batch release, FOH coordinator to sign-off on each batch)?

I attached the floor plan and dietary matrix we collected — helpful for kitchen prep. Also tagging Ops (Sean) because we may need staggered rides for the late arrivals — want to avoid a pileup at the loading zone.

Attachments: venue_floorplan.pdf (PDF), special_diets.csv (CSV)

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

From: Rosa Delgado <rosa@la_cucina_events.com>

Date: Wed, 09 Jul 2025 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening logistics for Thurs summit — staggered arrivals, late plates & kitchen handoff

Hi Marissa —

We can absolutely accommodate a short second pass for late arrivals. Proposed ops:

- Main plated service starts at 7:00pm as discussed (3-course plated).
- Kitchen will hold 24 heat-and-plate portions (kept warm in holding cabinets).
- FOH coordinator (Alejandro) will release two small batches at 7:45pm and 8:00pm based on the arrivals list you provide.
- For the VIP foyer, we will stage 30 passed hors d'oeuvres and keep entree timing independent; FOH will hold full entrée release until the main dining room call.

We will need a list of the 24 late attendees (names + any dietary flags) by Wednesday 4pm PT so the kitchen can mark plates and avoid cross-contact. We’ll provide one comms person at the kitchen pass to coordinate handoff and a mobile radio for FOH.

I’ve added a small add-on fee for the holding labor and two extra FOH staff in our estimate. If that’s ok, I’ll update the invoice and the venue staging doc.

Attachments: none

Thanks — Rosa

--
Rosa Delgado
